labels: 1-D numeric or bool, exactly 0/1, both classes present
scores: 1-D real int/float, finite, [0,1], same length 2..100000; larger scores favor label 1
weights: None or 1-D real finite [1e-6,1e6], same length; zero/negative weights excluded by teaching API
threshold: real non-bool scalar in [0,1] or +inf/-inf; >= convention
precision_at_no_predictions: returned as 0 with precision_defined=false; PR display endpoint uses 1 by separate convention
scope: binary one-label-per-record; no missing labels, zero-weight filtering, multiclass probabilities, ranking groups or arbitrary decision-function scale in the wrapper; sklearn itself supports more
